name: Nezu Jinpachi
source:
"I operate in favor of my Lord's objective. There is no other expectation above that."

Nezu Jinpachi is one of the Sanada Ten Braves. An enigmatic man who is rarely seen and never speaks much, but only continues to support Nobuyuki. What makes his heart stir...?

Temperament: Naturally cool. 
Likes: Daifuku
